findings.title: Insects, rodents, and animals not present.
findings.citation_text:
6-202.15(A) Outer Openings, Protected. (A) Except as specified in (B), (C), and (E) and under (D) of this section, outer openings of a FOOD ESTABLISHMENT shall be protected against the entry of insects and rodents by: (3) Solid, self-closing, tight-fitting doors. 

The front screen door to the facility is observed to not completely close at the time of this inspection. The latch is jammed in the open position and does not allow for complete closing. The situation was discussed with the PIC and they are instructed to repair/replace prior to the next routine inspection. Provide for tight fitting outer openings of the facility in order to prevent the entrance of pests.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.citation_text:
6-101.11(A)(3) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (3) Nonabsorbent for areas subject to moisture.

The hand sink in the women’s bathroom is currently pulling away from the wall and exposing a gap that is not easily cleanable. The PIC was shown and instructed to re-seal prior to the next routine insepction. Ensure that all areas subject to moisture are maintained with smooth and easily cleanable surfaces.
